_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ukiina Klondike Solitaire. Lengo lako ni kusonga kadi zote kwenye matumbawe ya msingi.

Sheria za Mchezo:
- Matumbawe ya msingi (F1-F4): Jenga kutoka Ace hadi Mfalme kwa suti
- Matumbawe ya meza (T1-T7): Jenga chini kwa kubadilisha rangi (nyekundu juu ya nyeusi, nyeusi juu ya nyekundu)
- Hisa: Chora kadi hadi kwenye taka
- Taka (W): Kadi ya juu inapatikana kwa mchezo

Maagizo:
- 'draw' - Chora kadi kutoka hisa hadi kwenye taka
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hamisha kadi kati ya matumbawe
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. idadi pia inaweza kuwa 'all', ambayo itajaribu kuhama kadi zote zilizo wazi.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza mchezo mara moja na uweke alama yako ya sasa
- Majina ya matumbawe: W (taka), F1-F4 (msingi), T1-T7 (meza)

Unaweza kutekeleza vitendo vingi katika zamu moja kwa kutenganisha kwa alama za koma:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Mfalme pekee anaweza kuwekwa kwenye matumbawe tupu ya meza.
Vitendo vinatendeka kwa mpangilio - ikiwa kimoja kinafeli, vitendo vilivyobaki vinapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ikiwa unaamini mchezo hauwezekani kushinda.

format_error.no_brackets: Muundo usio sahihi wa kitendo. Kitendo kinapaswa kuwa kati ya mabano.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Muundo usio sahihi wa kitendo. Mabano ya kufunga hayapo ']'
format_error.empty_command: Mĩaonĩ ĩsu vaeleetw'e ũndũ mũna mũsoanĩ ũsu. Kwa ngelekany'o, soma "draw" kana "move <source><destination> [count]".
format_error.move_needs_args: Agizo la kusonga linahitaji chanzo na lengo. Matumizi: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_invalid: Idadi si sahihi. Tumia nambari au 'all'

move_result.drew: Kadi imechorwa kutoka kwa hisa hadi taka.
move_result.cannot_draw: Haiwezekani kuchora. Hisa na taka zote ni tupu.
move_result.invalid_pile: Ĩsyĩtwa ĩte ya w'o. Tũmĩa W, F1-F4, kana T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: No ĩnyuve kaati ĩmwe katĩ wa ila mwĩ na vata nasyo.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Kaati ya kumya ũkũsĩ nĩyatũngiwe F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Ndũtonya kũsenzya kaati sya kwongeleela kyũmbanĩsyonĩ kĩu.
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Kadi ilihamishwa kutoka tableau T{src} hadi msingi F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Ndũtonya kũsenzya kaati sya kwonany'a vitio nthĩnĩ wa vulongulamu ĩsu ya kwambĩĩsya ĩthaũ
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Ndũtonya kũthi kũndũ na ndwĩsa kũvika vau ũendete.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Ĩka kũkusya kaati ĩmwe o vandũ vamwe.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Kadi ilihamishwa kutoka taka hadi tableau T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Ndũtonya kũlika kaati-inĩ ĩsu ya DAT kũndũ kũla kwĩthĩawa na mavisa ma ũla w'o.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Kadi {count} zimehamishwa kutoka tableau T{src} hadi T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Haiwezi kuhamisha {count} kadi(s) kutoka T{src} hadi T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Ĩka kũkusya kaati ĩmwe o vandũ vamwe.
move_result.foundation_empty: Foundation F{src} nĩ ĩthei na yĩ nthei.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Kadi ilihamishwa kutoka msingi F{src} hadi tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Ndũtonya kũlika kaati ya Foundation T{dst} ĩthangũnĩ yĩla yĩatĩĩe
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Kũu ũendete no nginya ũkate ngalĩ nĩ kana wĩthĩe ndwĩ na thĩna.

outcome.forfeit: Mchezo umeachwa. Alama ya mwisho: {score} kadi katika msingi.
outcome.won: Nĩtũũkũkatha nũndũ wa kũlika mathaũnĩ ma Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Mchezo umemalizika! Umeifikia idadi ya juu ya {max_turns} midundo. Alama: {score} kadi katika msingi.
